name: Echo Hostinger Variables (staging-only)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - staging
  # optional: allow manual runs (remove if you want strictly push-only)
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  show-vars:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Confirm branch (safety)
        run: |
          echo "GITHUB_REF = $GITHUB_REF"
          echo "Running on branch: ${GITHUB_REF#refs/heads/}"
        # extra guard: stop if not staging (shouldn't be necessary, but safe)
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/staging')

      - name: Echo repo variables
        run: |
          echo "HOSTINGER_HOST: ${{ vars.HOSTINGER_HOST }}"
          # If HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY is stored as a secret, use secrets instead:
          # echo "HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets.HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY }}"
          echo "HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY is present (masked if secret)."
        env:
          # If you stored the key as a secret, uncomment the next line and comment the vars line above
          # HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets.HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY }}
          HOSTINGER_HOST: ${{ vars.HOSTINGER_HOST }}
          HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY: ${{ vars.HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY }}
          HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY: ${{ vars.HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY }}
